protocol.architecture: original IAT CNN; Light PS CNN
protocol.context: healthy initial checkpoint; unchanged batch5/replay/LR; copies per domain
protocol.objective: maximize mean(p*original_paper_reward); no gap/gain/harm/cost terms or target centering
protocol.theory: original-paper reward control with compact contextual-bandit policy; not original DDQN or the continuous shared-gap zero-sum objective
protocol.features: 2*K+18; predictive uncertainty, paid-feedback coverage/novelty and causal budget/time
protocol.replay_probe: disabled; no copied Context/Adam, future-label probes or source-loss probes
protocol.normalization: feature moments fitted on TRAIN; discrete reward remains unscaled
protocol.policy: bounded logits; stochastic TRAIN requests; deterministic p>=.5 deployment; no forced spending
protocol.split: TRAIN/VAL 0/1/3; held source audit IDs/features excluded across levels; TEST only explicit Evaluate/All
protocol.selection: VAL online AC minus positive forgetting; fewer labels breaks ties
protocol.initialization: same healthy CNN/Context checkpoint; new compact query head trained on original reward
